applicabilityBasis.summary: USDSM is a transferable USD-referenced electronic money token with issuer par redemption; it is not a bank deposit or fund share.

genius.notes: USDSM is a USD-denominated e-money payment token redeemable at par by Stable mint Ltd, a Malta EMI. ESMA lists the exact USD whitepaper under Stable mint Ltd; this supports MiCA authorization only. No named GENIUS approval, application, state qualification or registered foreign exception was located in opened regulator material and targeted issuer-name searches. IssuerPathway and foreignExceptionStatus remain unknown; Malta EMI authorization is not U.S. PPSI permission. The issuer stablecoin page and terms disclose cash/HQLA backing and issuer-claimed overcollateralization, supporting public reserve-structure disclosure, not verified reserve adequacy or a monthly independent examination. No public monthly independent USDSM attestation was retrieved. Par redemption and payments are evidenced by the USD whitepaper/terms. not-yet-restricted describes pre-effective GENIUS timing and does not affirm U.S. distribution permissions under other applicable laws.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened federal proposals, SCRC certification procedure, state licensing list, issuer disclosures and targeted regulator-domain searches did not establish an issuer-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, or registered foreign exception for Stable mint Ltd / USDSM. Licensing or registration under earlier regimes is not such authorization. No public GENIUS-specific enforcement action was located in the checked sources; this is a bounded public-evidence review, not a legal compliance finding.
